trackStockPerVariant.title: Track inventory per variant
trackStockPerVariant.description: Maintain separate stock counts and low-inventory thresholds for each individual size, color, or option combination.

allowOutOfStockPurchases.title: Allow backorders on variants
allowOutOfStockPurchases.description: Permit shoppers to purchase variants even when the physical inventory count is zero.

maxVariantsPerProduct.title: Maximum variants per product
maxVariantsPerProduct.description: Upper limit of variant combinations permitted on a single catalog item.

hideUnavailableOptions.title: Hide discontinued variant combinations
hideUnavailableOptions.description: Do not show options on storefront selectors that have zero stock and no reorder planned.
